$comment: Who is where, what they say, and what asking gets you. 'gives' hands over an item the first time a topic is asked; 'pays' hands over coin once a condition holds. A topic asked twice is answered with the 'again' prefix, so a player checking continuity can see the town remembers.

sela.name: Warden Sela
sela.greet: Warden Sela looks up from the guard post. "Gate shuts at dusk. What do you need?"

topics.seal: the brass seal sits in the archive. Bring it, and the gate opens for you.
topics.gate: nobody leaves without the warden's seal. Orders came down this morning.
topics.dusk: the bell counts the hours. When it rings the last one, the gate is barred.
topics.wall: the wall walk is the sergeant's business. I keep the gate.
topics.town: quiet town. Too quiet since the archive keeper fell sick.

oren.name: Father Oren
oren.greet: Father Oren straightens a candle. "You look like someone in a hurry."

topics.archive: the keeper is abed, so I hold his key. Here, take it, and mind the dark in there.
topics.rats: there are rats in the cellar under us. Clear them out and I will see you paid.
topics.bell: the bell has a tongue and never says a word, yet the whole town hears it.
topics.graveyard: the old stones carry tokens the masons left. Nobody minds if you look.

marta.name: Marta the innkeeper
marta.greet: Marta wipes the long table. "A bed, a meal, or the news?"

topics.room: a rest by the fire costs a coin, and you will feel the better for it.
topics.news: they say a body with a rope could get down off the wall walk, if they had the nerve.
topics.ledger: sign the guest ledger and the inn remembers you. Type save whenever you like.
topics.child: Pell from the old quarter has been crying all day over something lost down the well.
topics.tokens: the masons hid three carved tokens about the town, long ago. Find them all and you have found the town.

coll.name: Coll the rope seller
coll.greet: Coll leans over a coil of rope. "Good hemp. Three coins."

topics.rope: three coins, and it will hold you down a well or off a wall. Say buy rope.
topics.archive: the archive door is locked while the keeper is sick. Father Oren has the key.
topics.fish: the fish is yesterday's. I would not.

pell.name: Pell
pell.greet: A child sits on a doorstep, red-eyed. "I dropped Gran's locket down the well."

topics.locket: it is silver, with Gran's picture in it. It went down the well and I cannot reach.
topics.tower: the iron door wants a word. Gran says it is the thing that calls the town but has no mouth.
topics.well: the winch is broken. You would need a rope to get down.

brask.name: Sergeant Brask
brask.greet: Sergeant Brask taps the sparring ring with a staff. "Fancy a round? A coin for every one you win."

topics.spar: step into the ring and say spar. A coin a win, up to three, and you will hit harder for it.
topics.wall: the wall walk is open. Getting down the outside needs a rope and a steady head.
topics.seal: the warden wants her seal. I want a decent sparring partner.
